items.caption: A modern redraw of 外 in an oracle-bone script style. One interpretation reads an early form as 卜 and takes the crack’s orientation to mark “outside”; this explanation remains disputed.
items.alt: A black angular glyph on white: a tall, slightly curved stroke on the left joins a long diagonal stroke rising to the upper right.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the oracle-bone style discussed for 外, while the disputed crack-orientation interpretation gives relevant context without treating the redraw as an artifact.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact image or a specific dated Shang witness. The earliest graph’s interpretation remains disputed.
